answer: A multi-agent network can resist Sybil attacks through proof-of-space-time challenges. Whether gathering telemetry from a sand dune, polar ocean, or distant nebula, each identity must prove continuous allocation of dedicated storage sectors via cryptographic plots. An attacker pays proportional capital and power costs to operate physical drives for every forged participant. However, repetitive auditing accelerates hardware wear, imposing heavy drive depreciation on honest nodes.
